name: value_head_single_step_v1
purpose: Test whether initial state-dependent value estimates cause undesirable actor probability changes in one controlled update, motivated by two Stop tokens in prior audit. Not a claim to reproduce original collapse or full backend equivalence.
selection: Ascending seeds; first new board in each quota. Exclude every prior recorded board and all actual historical candidate-prefix seeds, all reserved Test states, and duplicates within this selection. No outcome or model-response filtering.
model_phase_prerequisite: CPU data and runner checks PASS. Runtime before-generation guards still require actual tied embedding parameters and empty initial actor optimizer. Native-b0 rollout is the behavior source; known numerical discrepancy prevents claiming exact actor-backend on-policy equivalence.
planned_intervention: Same b0, same exact native-b0 collected32/order, fresh identical optimizer state, same LR/clip/GAE1/1/terminal reward/card library. Only original saved initial small value-head versus zeros. One global mini32/micro1 actor step per branch. No critic update; finite-horizon one-step mechanism comparison.
collection_gate: At least one of frozen16 target episodes succeeds; otherwise no update and no resampling to fill successes. No softening of old backend gates.
prior_backend_gate: FAIL retained; numerical-kernel branch closed. Any successor explicitly records known think-token discrepancies; no on-policy-backend equivalence claim.
scientific_boundaries: No regular multi-batch PPO expansion or300-step run
No solver action substitution or Stop blocking
Old b0/r0/checkpoints protected; no private raw or weights uploaded

planned_control_probes.selection: Exactly both pure Stop answer tokens identified in the already published original first32 audit; posthoc mechanistic probe, not fresh generalization.

planned_inference_snapshots.tied_alias_rule: Require actual input/output parameter identity and model tie_word_embeddings=True before any generation, drop only lm_head duplicate; config/key/header readability checked, no claim of full optimizer resume or independently tested reload.

scientific_metrics.mechanism_primary: For the two fixed historical Stop answer tokens, compare measured post-pre logprob changes Z minus O. Support this localized signal only if both differences<=0 and their mean<0. Report both tokens and all directions regardless of result; does not prove original collapse cause.
scientific_metrics.fresh_signal_strata: On all32 retained new episodes, report actual answer-token old/post logprobs and advantages split by target success/failure, Stop/nonStop; denominators retained, no filtering before actor update.
scientific_metrics.evaluation_gate: On frozen8 conditional+8 natural_multi panels, each branch has its own16 greedy b0 baseline and16 post-update episodes. Z conditional-quality gain>=1 and gain relative O own-change>=1; Z natural success and quality decline0, natural Stop/hole counts non-increasing. All conditions necessary for a bounded follow-up, not a scientific generalization claim.
scientific_metrics.paired_reporting: Per-seed success, BFS-quality, action count, Stop count, hole count; improvements/declines and exact paired intervals on all16 plus both8 strata; no seed replacement or theta selection.
scientific_metrics.failure_rule: If collection has zero target successes, skip both updates/no resampling. If update or finite/same-weight numerical guard fails, preserve all completed samples and exit; never replay completed actor step. If evidence gate fails, no automatic second actor step or larger training on this protocol.

data_preflight.identity: desc board regardless of player position

bounded_preupdate_repair.original_failure: Torch serialization of DataProto consolidated tensor views with different dtypes; incomplete704-byte file has no data.pkl/tensor payload. New diagnostic code serialization error, not original PPO defect.
bounded_preupdate_repair.original_phase_O: Complete16 b0 baseline,60 native calls; actor32+alignment16+critic32 complete but outputs lost before serialization; zero actor updates/probe forwards. All original files/logs retained.
bounded_preupdate_repair.repair: Clone each output tensor to independent CPU storage before torch.save. Reinitialize same b0/empty optimizer/initial O head, carry all16 original O b0 baselines with explicit new-worker limitation, rerun only unavailable oldlogp/values for32+alignment16. No completed environment episode or optimizer step is repeated.

analysis_details.interval: Conservative finite-sample95% paired rate difference: simultaneous97.5% Clopper-Pearson win/loss bounds with Bonferroni; exact discordant sign p also reported. No interval-based efficacy gate or multiplicity-adjusted claim.
analysis_details.Stop_metric: Actual parsed answer actions limited to original first5; report Stop turns and Stop episodes. Both must not increase on Z other-natural8, along with hole episodes. No thought-string matching.
analysis_details.analysis_timing: C and original O b0 baseline already observed; description fixed before inspecting any post-update result. Original numerical/scientific gates unchanged; extra alignment check can only withhold support.
